tei:div.tei:p: All shall thank thee; all shall praise thee; all shall declare There is none holy like the Lord! All shall forever extol thee, Creator of all. Thou, O God, openest daily the gates of the east, and cleavest the windows of the sky; thou bringest forth the sun from its place, and the moon from its abode, and givest light to the whole world and to its inhabitants whom thou hast created in thy mercy.

In mercy thou givest light to the earth and to those who dwell on it; in thy goodness thou renewest the work of creation every day, constantly. Thou alone, O King, art ever exalted! Thou art lauded, glorified and extolled from days of old. Eternal God, show us thy great mercy! Lord of our strength, thou art our secure Stronghold, our saving Shield, our Refuge.

There is none to be compared to thee, and there is none besides thee; there is none but thee. Who is like thee? There is none to be compared to thee, Lord our God, in this world, and there is none
besides thee, our King, in the life of the world to come; there is none but thee, our Redeemer, in the days of the Messiah; and there is none like thee, our Deliverer, during the revival of the dead.
